description: This is the main entry point for a React frontend application. It imports React and ReactDOM, along with the main App component and a CSS file, then initializes and renders the React application into the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React component tree.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React elements into the specified DOM node.
